item.title: Hardware UART Monitor: Snooping Serial Traffic with MSP430 LaunchPad
item.description: Related series articles: Why You Should Avoid the SIM900A GSM Module Connecting MSP430 to SIM900A While debugging UART communications, I needed a simple way to inspect the continuous message flow between the MSP430 microcontroller and the peripheral device (the SIM900 GSM modem) without altering timing characteristics. A straightforward hardware sniffing approach without dedicated logic analyzers: Extract the MSP430 MCU from the DIP socket on the LaunchPad and deploy it independently on a breadboard.
